Container.Overview: Curates the artist and composer metadata for your music library and gets it where it needs to go: into the artist.nfo files your servers read, pushed to Emby or Jellyfin over their APIs, or both. Per-library locking keeps your manual edits from being clobbered the next time a server refreshes.
Container.Description: Stillwater is a self-hosted web app that curates artist and composer metadata for your music library, then delivers it three ways: write artist.nfo files that Emby, Jellyfin, and Kodi all read cleanly, push edits straight to Emby and Jellyfin over their APIs, or do both. It only ever touches metadata and artwork, never your audio files. It pulls from ten metadata providers with per-field fallback (MusicBrainz, Fanart.tv, Discogs, TheAudioDB, Spotify, Last.fm, Deezer, Genius, Wikidata, and Wikipedia), so the indie, regional, classical, and non-Latin-script artists that leave other tools blank usually resolve here. Per-library edit locking keeps your manual corrections from drifting back every time a media server rewrites the file on refresh. A rule engine flags missing, inconsistent, or low-quality metadata and artwork and fixes it in bulk or one at a time, with a round-trip conflict check guarding every write-back. The artwork pipeline fetches, compares, and crops thumbnails, fanart, and logos side by side across sources.

Config.Name: Music Library
Config.Description: Path to your music library. Maps to /music inside the container.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions. Default 99 maps to nobody on Unraid.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions. Default 100 maps to users on Unraid.

Config.Name: Encryption Key
Config.Description: AES-256 encryption key for API secrets stored at rest. Auto-generated on first run if left blank. Set an explicit value to preserve access to stored secrets across container recreations.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Log verbosity: info, debug, warn, or error.

Config.Name: Log Format
Config.Description: Log output format: json or text.

Config.Name: Base Path
Config.Description: URL prefix for subfolder reverse proxy deployments, for example /stillwater. Leave blank for root deployments.
